turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
Walter says the food bank needs volunteers on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Take your time.
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. Yes, it was like that.
What happened next?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
What happened next?
I told Joy on the phone that I am not fine, and she said she is booking a flight.
Mm-hm. Go on.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. Yes, it was like that.
Take your time.
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say.
How did that feel for you?
Joy arrives on the fourteenth of February and will stay for ten days.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. It is not easy to talk about.
And how was that for you?
I poured out half the whisky bottle and I am down to one glass a night.
What went through your mind then?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
And how was that for you?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
Thank you, see you next week.
